descriptions.zh:
- 刷新预热类接口包含[RefreshObjectCaches](~~448057~~)刷新接口和[PushObjectCache](~~448058~~)预热接口。
- 单用户调用频率：20次/秒。
descriptions.en: Queries the maximum and remaining numbers of URLs and directories that can be refreshed, the maximum and remaining numbers of times that you can prefetch content, and the maximum and remaining numbers of URLs and directories that can be blocked on the current day.
